name: Planeta Envíos for WooCommerce
author: Planeta Envios

sections.description:
Planeta Envíos is the ultimate plugin to quote and display shipping options in your WooCommerce store. Connect your store with our API and offer your customers the best shipping options with the main carriers in Mexico.

Main Features

  • Real-time quotes – Get updated shipping prices instantly
  • Multiple carriers – DHL, FedEx, Estafeta, Paquetexpress, AMPM, iMile, UPS, Redpack
  • Automatic weight calculation – Uses physical or volumetric weight (whichever is greater)
  • Profit margin – Add an additional percentage to shipping costs
  • Carrier filter – Show only the carriers you want
  • Conditional free shipping – Configure free shipping from a certain amount
  • Smart cache – Reduces API calls and improves speed
  • Complete settings panel – Easy to configure from WooCommerce
  • Custom fields – Add specific weight and dimensions per product
  • Sandbox mode – Test integration without generating real labels
  • Shipping insurance – Optional insurance for shipments
  • Label generation – Create shipping labels directly from orders

Supported Carriers

  • DHL Express
  • FedEx
  • Estafeta
  • Paquetexpress
  • AMPM
  • iMile
  • UPS
  • Redpack

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Active account at Planeta Envíos with API Key

External Services

This plugin connects to external third-party services to provide its functionality.

Planeta Envíos API

This plugin sends shipping data (origin zip code, destination zip code, package weight, dimensions, and insurance details) to the Planeta Envíos API to obtain real-time shipping quotes and to create, cancel, and retrieve shipping labels.

  • Production API: https://api.planetaenvios.com/v1
  • Sandbox API: https://sandbox.planetaenvios.com/v1

Data is sent when:
* A customer views shipping options at checkout (quote request)
* A store administrator creates or cancels a shipping label from an order
* A store administrator tests the API connection from settings

Service website: https://planetaenvios.com
Terms of service: https://planetaenvios.com/terminos-y-condiciones
Privacy policy: https://planetaenvios.com/aviso-de-privacidad

Carrier Tracking Links

When a shipping label is created, the plugin generates a public tracking URL for the corresponding carrier so customers can track their shipment. These are standard public tracking pages — no API calls are made to the carriers, and no customer data is sent. The following carrier tracking pages may be linked:

  • DHL: https://www.dhl.com/mx-es/home/rastreo.html
  • FedEx: https://www.fedex.com/fedextrack/
  • Estafeta: https://www.estafeta.com/herramientas/rastreo
  • Paquetexpress: https://www.paquetexpress.com.mx/rastreo
  • UPS: https://www.ups.com/track
  • Redpack: https://www.redpack.com.mx/rastreo
  • AMPM: https://www.ampm.com.mx/rastreo
  • iMile: https://www.imile.com/tracking
sections.installation:
1. Upload the planeta-envios-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin from the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping > Planeta Envíos
  4. Enter your API Key
  5. Go to Planeta Envíos > My Addresses and add a sender address
  6. Add “Planeta Envíos” shipping method to a shipping zone for Mexico
  7. Done! Your customers will see shipping options at checkout

Configuration

API Key
Get your API Key from your dashboard at Planeta Envíos

Sender Address
Configure your sender addresses from Planeta Envíos > My Addresses menu.

Profit Margin
You can add an additional percentage to the shipping cost. For example, if you add 10%, a $100 shipment will show as $110.

Carriers
Select which carriers you want to show to your customers. Only quotes from enabled carriers will be shown.

Sandbox Mode
Enable sandbox mode to test the integration without generating real shipping labels.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Planeta Envíos account?

Yes, you need an active account with balance to use the quoting service.

Does the plugin calculate volumetric weight?

Yes, if you configure package dimensions (length, width, height), the plugin will automatically calculate volumetric weight and use the greater between physical and volumetric weight.

Can I add a profit margin?

Yes, in the settings you can set a percentage that will be added to the shipping cost shown to the customer.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes, the plugin takes the weight from the parent product for variations.

What happens if the API doesn’t respond?

You can configure a default shipping cost that will be shown when the API is not available.

What is Sandbox mode?

Sandbox mode allows you to test the integration using the test environment. Labels created in sandbox are not real.
